description: This file contains utility functions for generating curl and fetch commands from network request data, including platform-specific escaping functions and handling of request headers and post data.

methods.name: generateCurlCommand
methods.description: Generates a cURL command string from a trace model and network resource entry, with platform-specific escaping and header handling.

methods.name: generateFetchCall
methods.description: Generates a JavaScript fetch API call string from a trace model and network resource entry, with options for browser or Node.js style.
